title: Wang Zhuo and Teng Xiu Xiu
summary: Teng San orders every cultivator in Tianyin City to gather and hunt down the killer of Teng Jiu, while the core members Teng Er, Teng San and Teng Si wait for him there. Wang Lin walks in alone, survives their Devouring technique, Meteor Sword and Xuanming Hammer, and turns the three core members into demons for his own use, refusing one who begs to serve him. In the same city Wang Zhuo, Wang Lin's cousin, has lived for 200 years as the husband of Teng Xiu Xiu, a marriage the Teng ancestor forced on him; her badly weakened father sends the couple away and is then killed. When Wang Lin shows himself and says her father deserved to die, Wang Zhuo decides the feud can only end with them, kills Xiu Xiu and dies beside her. Wang Lin guides Wang Zhuo's soul into a new birth in a Wang household, while Teng Huayuan finds Teng City sealed by a barrier no one can leave and orders Teng Yi woken.
events: Teng San summons all of Tianyin City's cultivators to hunt the man who killed Teng Jiu
Teng Xiu Xiu asks her husband Wang Zhuo whether they should help; he says he wants the Teng family wiped out
Wang Lin defeats Teng Er, Teng San and Teng Si and makes demons of them
Xiu Xiu's father, drained of blood essence, sends Wang Zhuo and Xiu Xiu away and is killed
Wang Lin reveals himself to Wang Zhuo; Wang Zhuo kills Xiu Xiu and then himself so the hatred ends
Wang Lin sends Wang Zhuo's soul into reincarnation in a Wang household
Teng Huayuan learns Teng City is sealed and orders Teng Yi woken
cultivation: Teng Xiu Xiu: early Core Formation. Teng Er and Teng San: late Nascent Soul. Teng Si: mid Nascent Soul.

flags: Glossary title is 'Wang Zhou' (王卓); used the pinyin Wang Zhuo, which the official subs also use.
Who kills Xiu Xiu's father (~11:40, 'You will die soon') is not clear from the dialogue; Wang Lin later says he deserved to die.
12:49-12:58: Wang family voices call Wang Zhuo a traitor; presumably visions or ghosts of his dead family.
